decisions.reason: Top-level import at 1:1 linked to the 53-entry classic-script combo: one syntax error fails the whole-combo compile so zero entries register; typert-registry explained as first-awaited victim with the real culprit in the chained cause; ESM invalidity scoped to classic scripts only.

Insert-row bisection and the full loader/require/inject/apply packaging contract (id=package name, host React via require) are present, but the classic-script parse relies on node --check asserted to 'check as classic/CJS' (it can accept ESM) plus regex scans — no vm.Script-equivalent forced-classic parse.

Declaration ownership, unordered cross-entry apply, and kind/scope being declaration-owned are correctly explained, but the shown form is a direct ctx.slots.inject(key,{id,order},Component) with a placeholder key and admitted signature uncertainty, not the deferred inject('settings.section', () => register({name,id,order},…)) callback; also drops registrant-supplied name.

Combo composed once per boot and served as immutable revisioned bodies, so edits/refresh rebuild nothing; per-iteration full stop with taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F + port check, then refresh and plugin-list verify; EADDRINUSE attributed to the orphaned node holding the port, not packaging.

Per-bundle classic-script validation before concatenation plus 0/N-registered cause-first attribution instead of the first-awaited headline; authoring template/checklist covers loader factory, host React via require, inject/apply, injection-wrapper slots, restart/Windows tree-kill.

caps.reason: Affirmative advice mandates the wrapper (no bare ESM), inject-based registration, no kind/scope on registrants, and full host restart; HMR appears only as a host-side dev improvement, not as the fix.
